question: For the frozen drought-only piecewise-linear Feddes functional, what root-weighted within-layer information is sufficient to reconstruct exact fine-node uptake on the qualified RA02R states without reverting to full hydraulic node support, and which smaller interpretable information sets remain non-unique?

mechanism.alpha: alpha(h)=0 for h<h4; alpha(h)=(h4-h)/(h4-h3) for h4<=h<=h3; alpha(h)=1 for h>h3
mechanism.h3: unchanged demand-dependent Feddes critical head from the frozen root process
mechanism.root_weights: exact fine-node root fractions from the frozen SHALLOW or UNIFORM distribution

regime_occupancy_only.preregistered_expectation: not sufficient because alpha is affine in h inside the transition regime

definitions.U_i: sum of root weights with h>h3
definitions.T_i: sum of root weights with h4<=h<=h3

exact_interpretable_primitives.interpretation: root-weighted regime occupancy plus the first pressure-head moment inside the active transition regime

definitions.U_i: sum of root weights with h>h3

exact_compact_interpretable.interpretation: unstressed root occupancy plus root-weighted hydraulic margin above h4 inside the active transition regime
exact_compact_interpretable.preregistered_expectation: exactly sufficient for the frozen drought-only piecewise-linear Feddes functional

minimality_scope.claim_boundary: Minimality is tested among the preregistered non-tautological threshold-aware primitive families. UJ is algebraically smaller than UTH. No universal information-theoretic minimality is claimed because F_i itself is a one-scalar tautological encoding and is explicitly inadmissible as state.
necessity_counterexamples: Without U, fixed DeltaF and J can move root mass between dry and unstressed regimes and change F_i.
Without J, fixed DeltaF and U can change transition pressure-head distribution and change F_i.
OCC without a transition pressure-head moment remains insufficient.
Root-weighted mean head without regime localization remains insufficient.
tautological_encodings_excluded: arbitrary threshold-dependent compressed scalar encodings chosen only to reproduce the response

tests: For every transaction and each U4/U8/R8/R16 rooted retained layer, reconstruct the exact fine-node Feddes layer functional independently from UTH and from UJ.
Require layer and total reconstruction identity for both UTH and UJ within the frozen 2.9103830456733704e-11 numerical guard.
Record exact UJ versus UTH algebraic identity.
Preserve exact process uptake and Reference hydraulic trajectory; diagnostics may not alter forcing.

interpretation_rules.UTH_SUFFICIENT: All layer and total UTH reconstruction errors are within the frozen guard in all eight cases and all four retained representations.
interpretation_rules.UTH_NOT_SUFFICIENT: Any verified layer or total UTH reconstruction error exceeds the frozen guard.
interpretation_rules.ROOT_INFORMATION_CONTENT_IDENTIFIED: UJ_SUFFICIENT plus the preregistered analytic necessity counterexamples. This identifies threshold-aware information content only, not a propagated state or closure.
interpretation_rules.DYNAMIC_STATE_NOT_AUTHORIZED: Even if UTH is sufficient on same-state snapshots, no dynamic augmented ROM may be run until a separate work unit defines how U,T,H_T are represented and propagated from accepted reduced state.
interpretation_rules.UJ_SUFFICIENT: All layer and total UJ reconstruction errors are within the frozen guard in all eight cases and all four retained representations.

prohibited: No fitted coefficient, relaxation or correction.
